nextStoryContext: archivePatternsOnMain (src/commands/patterns-archive.ts) is marker-based only: a bullet moves to scripts/cam/patterns.archive.md iff RESOLVED_MARKER_RE (`/\[resolved \d{4}-\d{2}\]/`, exported) matches anywhere in its text; no threshold/age/count logic. Blocks are parsed by finding lines starting with '- ' (top-level bullets); everything before the first such line is the preserved intro preamble. patterns.archive.md is lazily created (git show returning non-zero -> bootstrap header '# Codebase Patterns Archive'). Guard order and plumbing mirror src/commands/journal-archive.ts exactly (checkMainUpToDate -> read-from-main -> parse -> mutate -> commitTreeToMain([2 FileWrite]) -> pushMainBestEffort), all imported from src/git/on-main.ts, no private copy. US-002 (CLI wiring: `cam patterns archive` + help + sentinel) should call archivePatternsOnMain the same way journal.ts calls archiveJournalOnMain -- look at how `cam journal archive` is registered in index.ts for the wiring shape. US-004 (retrofit markers) must use the exact same regex `[resolved YYYY-MM]` when tagging existing scripts/cam/patterns.md bullets, and should document the convention (probably as a new bullet at the top of patterns.md or in CLAUDE.md) so future contributors know how to mark a bullet resolved.
